facts.fact: BCEAO developed and runs the PI-SPI instant payment platform, in service in Togo with 17 connected providers and 24-hour operation, per TogoTimes.
Togo's providers are connected to the WAEMU-wide PI-SPI, with about 3.9 million Togo users at end-October 2026, per TogoTimes.

systems.tiers: banks, e-money issuers, microfinance institutions, payment institutions

TGO.note: Fee rules only; no consumer-protection rule or complaints body stated.

facts.fact: Togo takes part in the BCEAO's PI-SPI, which links providers across the WAEMU, with 17 Togo providers connected at end-October 2026, per TogoTimes.

TGO.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: Since 2 November 2026 interoperable e-money transactions between individuals in the WAEMU must go through PI-SPI, per TogoTimes.

TGO.note: Wallet counts only, no survey of adults.

facts.fact: Togo e-money transactions in 2025 reached CFAF 4,435 billion in 409.7 million operations, with 5.69 million active wallets, per TogoTimes.
PI-SPI allows instant transfers between different providers including banks and e-money issuers, and is mandatory for interoperable person-to-person e-money since 2 November 2026, per TogoTimes.

TGO.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
